page.description: Solus 2026-04-18 ISOs: Budgie, GNOME, Plasma and Xfce, with sizes and per-image SHA-256 files.
page.intro: An independent distribution with its own package manager (eopkg) and a curated set of desktops. Four images, one per desktop.
pros: Independent: not a rebuild of another distribution.
Four desktop editions from the same build date.
eopkg with a rolling, curated package set.
Each image has its own published SHA-256 file.
cons: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Solus; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image per desktop, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The version is the build date (2026-04-18).
